title: Mount Baker Climb Tour from Washington
includes: Backpacking, mountaineering, and general outdoor safety skills
Pre-trip Planning/Information session on packing & gear
requirements: Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb: Join us for 3 days of climbing to the summit of one of North America’s most sought after peaks, Mount Baker. We take either the Easton Glacier or Coleman-Demming route with challenging route-finding through icefalls, seracs, and around large crevasses. Before summiting Mount Baker, you will learn fundamental skills necessary for safe glacier travel such as ice axe arrest, the use of crampons, and how to attach to a rope as a member of a rope team.
